context.problem: Choose Gleanmo’s Clojure framework and interaction approach, separating Biff 2 adoption from Datastar adoption.
constraints: This matrix assumes Clojure remains the application language. Revisit it if the language decision selects a rewrite.
Postgres integration is retained as a stated criterion. Revisit it if the database decision selects another database.
These options are editable starting points, not an exhaustive list of combinations.

completion_guidance.blank_values: Null weights and scores are unassessed, not zero. Empty notes and conclusions await user input.
completion_guidance.weights: Set each weight to low, medium, or high when ready.
completion_guidance.scores: Use 0 through 5, with higher scores always indicating a better fit. For effort, cost, risk, and churn, lower burden scores higher.
completion_guidance.comparison: Assess migration costs separately from ongoing benefits. Record concrete stack and hosting assumptions in option notes before scoring.
completion_guidance.ownership: The user will provide assessments. No option has been ranked or selected.

options.label: Biff 1 + HTMX
options.description: Retain the current framework and interaction approach.

options.label: Biff 2 + HTMX
options.description: Adopt Biff 2 components while retaining HTMX interactions. Assess the integration work explicitly.

options.label: Biff 2 + Datastar
options.description: Adopt Biff 2 and replace the relevant HTMX interactions with Datastar.

options.label: Independent Clojure libraries + HTMX
options.description: Compose the required Clojure libraries directly and retain HTMX, replacing Biff integration as needed.

criteria.label: Framework maintenance outlook
criteria.description: Expected availability of fixes, support, and maintainers for the selected composition.

criteria.label: Useful new capabilities
criteria.description: Value of capabilities that address actual Gleanmo needs.

criteria.label: Interaction simplicity
criteria.description: Ease of implementing and maintaining browser and server interactions.

criteria.label: Existing UI compatibility
criteria.description: Fit with existing forms, Choices.js widgets, timers, and visualizations.

criteria.label: Debugging clarity
criteria.description: Ease of tracing requests, state changes, rendering, and failures.

criteria.label: Testing ease
criteria.description: Ease of verifying application behavior reliably.

criteria.label: Learning effort
criteria.description: Work required to understand the chosen components and conventions.

criteria.label: Migration effort
criteria.description: Work required to change framework integration, interactions, and tests.

criteria.label: Postgres integration
criteria.description: Ease of using PostgreSQL directly across application data, authentication, and background work.

criteria.label: Component independence
criteria.description: Ease of replacing or omitting individual libraries and framework conventions.

criteria.label: Ongoing churn
criteria.description: Expected burden of API changes, upgrades, and recurring integration changes.
